svg.text: Route: /admin · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• Landing page after sign-in. Every dish is made from a bill of materials (panel feedback), so stock is counted in raw materials, plus the ready-made items (sold as they are, counted in
pieces). The notice and the Needs restock / Out of stock tiles count both.
• The notice shows only when something is at or below its minimum. See more and Needs restock open Raw materials filtered to what needs restocking (14, ?filter=low), Out of stock to what
has none left (?filter=out); when only ready-made items match, they open the Ready-made tab (14f).
• Level: OK, LOW (a ready-made item at or below its minimum) or OUT. A dish runs low when one of its raw materials does, which the notice reports. Inventory value is the raw materials and
• The second notice (GET /api/inventory/freshness) lists items to use soon: the oldest stock on hand (assuming the oldest is used first) near or past the days it stays fresh, counted from
its market purchase, or a packaged item within 7 days of its printed date. See items opens Raw materials, which shows the same notice.
